name: SiN
//queryPortOffset: Servers answer GameSpy queries on the port before the one players join; their reply names that port.
//text: Quake 2 engines mark coloured text with the high bit, which only their own font can show.
//masters: The only master that lists SiN servers; 333networks and OpenSpy know the game but list none.

keys.//password: SiN's GameSpy reply never says whether a server wants a password, so none shows as needing one.

password.//maxLength: Info_SetValueForKey refuses 64 characters or more, so a longer password would never reach the server.
password.//refusedCharacters: SiN reads its command line as Quake 2 does: '+' starts the next command, a space adds a word that set refuses, '$' is expanded, and userinfo refuses '"', '\' and ';'.
